title: curriculum
description: What is taught: one curriculum in the LAUNCH portfolio, such as an introduction to AI use. A class points at one curriculum (class.curriculum_id). The record says how long the teaching takes (sessions and minutes per session); who may teach it is kept on the instructor roster. Each session of a multi-session curriculum is its own class. Rules the schema cannot express: slug is unique (soft-deleted records count) and never changes; status defaults to active.
x_retention: Keep curricula until the owner deletes them; a deleted curriculum stays in the database. (A written policy only; nothing enforces it yet.)

slug.description: A short unique identifier for the curriculum: lowercase letters, digits and underscores, such as intro_ai_use. Never changes once set. Required.

title.description: What people see: 'Introduction to AI Use'. Up to 200 characters. Required.

tagline.description: One short marketing line shown with the title, for example 'Put down the keyboard. Pick up the conversation.' Up to 120 characters. Optional.

description.description: What the curriculum covers, in a few sentences. Up to 2000 characters. Optional.

session_count.description: How many sessions the curriculum takes: 1 for a single session, more for a series. A whole number from 1 to 50. Optional; when absent it is one session.

minutes_per_session.description: How long each session lasts, in minutes. A whole number from 5 to 600. Optional.

status.description: active (offered when building a class) or inactive (kept, not offered). Optional on create; the server sets active when absent.

notes.description: Free text for the operator. Up to 2000 characters. Optional.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. A deleted link is a mistake corrected, not a relationship that ended. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
